intro.text: I'll leave you to that.
Kira. Are you all right?

intro.text: Argh! We've waited too long as it is--something is wrong, I'm sure of it!
Teeseven! You found the ship with Satele Shan and her students?
Impressive.
I realize this is something you must do without me, but I couldn't let you go without at least wishing you luck.
...Now it's the compressor!
Arrrgh!
That's an Eternal Empire shuttle. From Zakuul.
These corpses....
There you are.
Critical damage... circuits failing....

qst.an-opportunity-too-good-to-pass-up: An Opportunity Too Good to Pass Up
An Opportunity Too Good to Pass Up

intro.text: That Sith and her beasts... if you hadn't been here, they'd have torn us to pieces.
Welcome, Master Jedi. How did our humble settlement earn this honor?
I told you, agent. This Jedi never fails.
I warned him. I told Rieekan this base was compromised.
These Jedi relics are remarkably well preserved, Captain. Quite worth your ridiculous asking price.

qst.an-opportunity-too-good-to-pass-up: An Opportunity Too Good to Pass Up

qst.an-opportunity-too-good-to-pass-up: An Opportunity Too Good to Pass Up

intro.text: Called us monsters. Mad with terror.
General, the chemical plant is ours. The Sith never finished their bomb.
I'll get us through this door. Hang on.
You're fast, but not fast enough. Executor Krannus is gone.
If you hadn't come here... We owe you our lives.
[The warfare prototypes are hidden inside this unlocked containment vault.]
You violate the Emperor's sanctum. There is only one punishment.
Such skill. So much power. Impressive.
I got as many trauma kits as I could find.
Have you accessed the Imperial network?
I've done some crazy things, but this beats them all.
If you must kill me, at least tell me why.
You truly are a stubborn one. Won't be satisfied until you've completely inconvenienced me, will you?
The Death Mark has been destroyed. Your people are safe.
Right on time. You're practically a droid. I knew if I applied the right stimulus, you couldn't resist coming here.
Stop... stop! I... where are we?
Welcome home. The Jedi owe you a debt of gratitude we can never repay.
I need to know something. Do you think you're making a difference?
I know your face. The one who defeated Darth Angral. The hero of Tython.
No--please!
Doctor Gantrell, I presume.

qst.impending-doom-to-the-power-core: Impending Doom: To the Power Core

intro.text: Why do you insist on being a slave? With your power, you could do--be--anything.
When I heard about the fighting on Corellia, I knew they'd send you. And now my patience is rewarded.
Imperial war droids make good scrap....
Stupid Empire and its Mandalorian mercenaries! Those flying bucket-heads shot every bottle in the cantina!
The hero of Tython... you're a welcome sight!
Violence. Suffering. Death. Sel-Makor feeds on the fallen.
The Jedi bought us time. Get our wounded to the secure area. Move it!
Hey, look at that. We're alive. Nice work.
Ah! Master Braga told me you were coming. Warren Sedoru--a pleasure.
General Var Suthra, I've shut down the cruiser's reactors. I repeat, the battle cruiser is under my control.
We're at the point of no return, my friend. Win or lose, this is where we'll make our stand.
That's the last scrambler. Now to get a fix on that signal....
Huh! A Jedi. Never killed one of your kind before.
Got here soon as we could. Had to engage some Imperial patrols in our way, but nothing serious.
Nothing serious? You should've sent Privates Vanth and Edder back to base. Those blasted turrets killed them both!
Facility power is back online. I'm afraid that's the only good news I have.
Running a thermal scan... whoa, the technician wasn't kidding. Something's really lighting up. Tracking....
Jedi filth... you've killed my son!
Only one building in the sector maintained a steady energy supply when you disrupted those power conduits.
We've been waiting for you, Jedi.
Stop... I'm... I'm in control....
Mark Threes are tougher than I thought. Not much left of me, is there?
You shouldn't have come. He'll make me hurt you.
You're strong to have made it this far. But not strong enough.
That was the Death Mark laser. It killed Count Alde.
Heh... what took you so long?
Doc? What are you doing here?
Be reasonable, Duke. Your calls for peace are misguided, unnecessary.
I have the Imperial survey maps of the starship graveyard.
Impatience got the better of me. I blundered in here like a Padawan. The heavy turrets were an unpleasant surprise.
Sorry I couldn't meet you. We've got a full-scale Imperial invasion on our hands. They caught us by surprise.
Leeha Narezz sent me. Looks like I got here just in time.
Bad news, my friend. The Empire just landed heavy war droids in the region. Hunter-Killers.
That's enough bloodshed. Let's be professional about this.
Count Alde? I'm an associate of Master Orgus Din. I'm here about the Death Mark project.
Master Satele, my mission has become more complicated. Masters Orgus and Kiwiiks have disappeared.
Greetings. I am Valis. Your quick response is most appreciated.
Stay back! Stop talking. You're not real. None of you.
My Master sent you, didn't he? Of course. My shame is complete.
The Emperor's Wrath is gone. He isn't coming back for you.
I hoped you would come. Our prior meeting terminated unsatisfactorily.
Kira? You're here!
I'll requisition my gear and meet you at your ship.
"Boom-boom" making big hole in planet--and Brrik finding more problems!
Quiet, finally... I can breathe again. I've been down here so long....
That's the second field agent who's missed a check-in. Our network's under attack.
Chief Rieekan? I've downloaded all of Agent Galen's coded messages.
A Jedi! See, Brrik? I told you help would come.
Go home, Jedi--or the White Maw will devour you.
Uhh... Jedi? Thank the stars.
That was the last of the Imperials. You're safe now.

intro.fullCondition: (qst.utility.misc.is_male = true AND qst.utility.class.is_jedi_knight = true AND qst.location.voss.class.jedi_knight.visionsoflightanddarkness.go_meet_tala_reh = true)

intro.text: Outsider. A victory well-earned. My vision nears completion.
It is done. Tala-Reh's sacrifice heralds a new age of peace for this world.
Looks like you two made it. And you're Garith, I'm guessing?
Hey, wait up! Phew, you even walk fast.
I mean no offense, my lord. But consider: the psychological impact of losing five thousand civilians to one Jedi....
Captain Maddox. I've defeated Colonel Blight. Camp Sovereign's ready for you.
Try to hold on, Tav. The Jedi will be here soon, and then you can rest.
Override engaged. You can fire the Seekers.
You've got good timing, Captain. I've just finished securing the Bosnar Dam.
Report, Captain.
Warning: Structural integrity at twenty-two percent. Release pressure at valve sixteen or forty-seven to avoid catastrophic failure.
Sorry to trouble you, Master Jedi... but when it comes to Sith Lords, seems we're pretty useless on our own.
That armor looks too thick for lightsabers. Any missile launchers lying around out here?
Nice moves, Master Jedi. Lightsabers ought to work now!
Next time we stop to catch our breath, let's talk.
When we're back at the ship, don't run off to practice your lightsaber forms. I'd like a chat--in private.
Relief supplies ready for delivery. My friends are waiting--let's go.
Suri needs help. Let's not keep her waiting.
I don't like it. This mission has "trap" written all over it.
Look on the bright side... now you know all my dark secrets. No more surprises here.
Wouldn't it be great if the general called us to say good morning--just once? But no, it's always the end of the galaxy....
I have some frustrations I'd like to take out on these Imperials.
It doesn't make up for Uphrades, but score one for the Republic.
I knew he couldn't keep you forever. That control panel will free me. Use it.
You can't let them do this. I know you're still in there!
We need to find the others before this whole place comes down on us.
At this point, I don't know what to believe. Let the Council sort it out.
intro.fullCondition: (qst.utility.class.is_jedi_knight = true AND (((qst.location.open_world.republic.act_2.jedi_knight.an_unthinkable_alliance.go_to_jedi_council = true AND custom.missing.quest.variable = true))))

intro.text: Can't wait to get all this sand out of my boots. Can we leave this party?
I can barely feel Master Kiwiiks anymore. We need to hurry.
I can sense Master Kiwiiks in pain. We need to find her.
Not sure which climate is worse... Taris or Tatooine. Maybe a tie?
Master Kiwiiks... she's alive. She's asking to talk to you.

intro.fullCondition: ((qst.utility.class.is_jedi_knight = true OR qst.utility.class.is_jedi_wizard = true OR qst.utility.class.is_trooper = true OR qst.utility.class.is_smuggler = true) AND qst.exp.02.forged_alliances.republic.forged_alliances.qm_completed_part_3 = true)

intro.text: Very good.

intro.fullCondition: ((qst.utility.class.is_sith_sorcerer = true OR qst.utility.class.is_sith_warrior = true OR qst.utility.class.is_bounty_hunter = true OR qst.utility.class.is_spy = true) AND qst.flashpoint.corellia.corellia_story_wrapper_imp.qm_entered_dark_council = true)

intro.text: I got your files--but the thief transmitted a decrypted copy to Black Sun.
Just in time. These guys get points for courage, but we're a little outnumbered.
No one saw this coming, Master Satele--not even the Jedi Council.
A Sith, working as my chief scientist! How can I defend the Republic if I can't trust my own people?
May the Force be with us.
This is going to be way more exciting than Jedi training.
We should get back to the Senate tower.
I'm with you to the end, but I hope it's a long ways off.
General Var Suthra's in a panic. Maybe you can calm him down.
I'll handle this. You should report to Agent Galen.
Go on, then. I'll wait here and think about the Jedi Code or something.
I'll use Agent Galen's fancy terminal to clear a path inside the guild's headquarters. Have fun....
Heard about your shuttle trip. Wish I'd been there.
We need answers--and I see the guy who's going to give them to us. Shall we?
I'm waiting for your signal.
You will not steal my victory. Not now.
This Child is unfinished. Weak. I will make her strong.
Angral pulled out all the stops for us. We must be doing something right.
If we don't get out of here, we're dead.
This Council meeting ought to be interesting. They owe you their lives.
You will not steal my victory. Not now.
Angral's dead--and this battle cruiser's not far behind him.
This Child is unfinished. Weak. I will make her strong.
So your Master was here all along. Well-played, Padawan. Your lies convinced even Darth Angral.
Don't take this the wrong way, but I've never been happier to see anyone my whole life.
You know the worst thing about Darth Angral? His breath.
Why don't we deal with all these Sith before we start the small talk? What do you say?
Let's begin. It's a simple device. Three inducement settings, each inflicting greater pain on the subject.
Teeseven said you were about to be killed.
The six of us against a whole planet. I almost feel sorry for them.
Won't take the Empire long to realize we're here. Better move fast.
What if we pretend we're going to a costume party dressed as Jedi? Think they'd buy it?
It was close, but we all made it.
Been doing some light reading lately. Amazing, what's tucked away in the Jedi Archives.
That whole "Jedi aren't allowed to feel emotions" rule? Don't get it. Sure, anger's bad. Why cross off everything else?
This is a nice ship. Shame we don't spend more time here.
Finally got the skinny on how we become an official Jedi twosome. Short version? Not happening.
All right, tough guy. We need to have "the talk." Know the one I mean?
Step away from my ship. We're leaving.

intro.fullCondition: ((qst.utility.class.is_jedi_knight = true OR qst.utility.class.is_jedi_wizard = true OR qst.utility.class.is_trooper = true OR qst.utility.class.is_smuggler = true) AND qst.exp.02.forged_alliances.republic.forged_alliances.qm_completed_part_3 = true)

intro.text: Starting to see why the Council disapproves of Jedi getting involved with each other.
intro.fullCondition: (qst.utility.misc.is_male = true AND qst.utility.class.is_jedi_knight = true AND qst.companion.republic.jedi_knight.kira_carsen.conversations.romance3worried.experienced_alternate_ending = true)

intro.text: You saved our galaxy from destruction. The Emperor's death has turned the tide of this war.
I've docked inside the Emperor's fortress. No sign of opposition.
Ever since our dance with Darth Angral, I've felt different--"good" different. No more Emperor in my head.
I will fly us to the Emperor's temple, but you must face him alone. No one else can resist his direct influence.
We've landed on Dromund Kaas. Any sign we've been detected?
Master Satele, the Emperor is dead. Do you read me? The Emperor is dead.
Ever wonder who you'd be, if the Jedi hadn't taken you in?
General, the Death Mark has been destroyed--and I have news about Master Orgus.
General? We got a little scorched, but we're inside Angral's battle cruiser.
Know what gets me? Wasting all our time blowing up bad guys.
The Force is with you--now and always.
General. Doctor Godera's on his way to you.
A major tactical advantage has just opened up, but you have to act quickly.
We narrowly escaped a major disaster, General--but a lot of good people died.
Still remember the first time I met you on Tython.
Spent enough time with Master Kiwiiks to know how Jedi should behave. You? Not doing it.
Funny trivia... that gang on Nar Shaddaa I wiped out? The Ur'kossags? Tried to recruit me away from the refugees.
General, I've arrived at Ord Mantell.
T7 = transmitting files now
Want to hear something crazy? I've done more fighting as a Jedi than during my entire Sith training.
Been making an effort lately to increase my openness. I'm even extending the courtesy to people like you.
Not a great time, all right? Don't we have a planet to save somewhere?
intro.fullCondition: (qst.utility.misc.is_male = true AND qst.utility.class.is_jedi_knight = true AND qst.companion.republic.jedi_knight.kira_carsen.conversations.romance2angry.experienced_alternate_ending = true)

intro.text: So when do I get my own Padawan? Always wanted to be a teacher.
You're not like most Jedi. That's a compliment.
This thing we've got? Biggest mistake of our lives.
intro.fullCondition: (qst.utility.misc.is_male = true AND qst.utility.class.is_jedi_knight = true AND qst.companion.republic.jedi_knight.kira_carsen.conversations.romance1breakup.experienced_alternate_ending = true)

qst.put-the-past-in-a-box: Put the Past in a Box

intro.text: Master Braga... the mission to Balmorra was a success. We have the cloaking device prototype.
This is Jedi Knight Leeha Narezz. Please identify.
The admiral was never here, General. This was a trap.
Just got an interesting holomessage. Childhood friend of mine. Think you'll want to see it....
Been thinking about that bad party we went to on Voss. Raises a lot of questions.
Need a time-out. Got something on Nar Shaddaa that can't wait.
General, I've arrived on Nar Shaddaa. Still no word from Agent Galen?
General, I'm on Tatooine. Has Master Kiwiiks reported in?
Don't know what Master Satele was thinking, sending you out to save the galaxy. The Jedi must be hard up.
No sign of Darth Angral, but Uphrades... I saw this planet once, with Master Kiwiiks. It used to be green.
So. Ground rules? Master Kiwiiks let me do whatever, long as I wasn't in her way.
Look, I'm irresistible. It's only natural you want to be around me. But this is too much!
Everything's running smooth. Maybe we should go look for a dogfight or something. Liven up the joint, huh?
We've arrived at New Uphrades, Master Satele. What's the colony's status?
What's our status, Master Satele?
Very good.
If I never see another blast crater in my life, it'll be too soon....
At the rate things are going, there won't be anything left of Balmorra to fight over.
This planet is officially off my relaxing vacation list.
Master Kiwiiks used to tell me stories about the last war. I wonder what she thinks of Balmorra....
Master Orgus sent us. We came as quickly as we could.
I searched the temple archives. This Force user leading the Flesh Raiders never received Jedi training.
I think you'd better talk to Master Orgus.
Why do I get the feeling you're not supposed to be here?
Well aren't you something special? See you around....
Considering things here, leaving for Coruscant doesn't sound so bad.
